data.one_liner: Web‑only Flutter plugin to record microphone audio and retrieve it as a URL or bytes.
data.what_it_does: It creates a MicrophoneRecorder that can start and stop recordings on the web. After stopping, the audio is available via a URL and can be converted to raw bytes. The recorder is a ValueNotifier for state listening.
use_when: You need to capture microphone audio in a Flutter web app
You want a simple API to start/stop recording and get a playback URL
avoid_when: You need recording on mobile platforms (iOS/Android)
You require advanced audio processing or format control
strengths: Very small API, easy to start/stop
Provides both URL and raw byte access
weaknesses: Web‑only, no support for mobile or desktop

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform audio recorder supporting mobile, web and desktop
